newsitem.title: PORTUGAL: Portuguese bonds end lower on U.S. NAPM.
newsitem.headline: Portuguese bonds end lower on U.S. NAPM.

text.p: Portuguese bonds ended lower in sympathy with European markets after U.S. NAPM data underlined a buoyant U.S. economy.
"The good performance of the U.S. economy is not good for the debt market as it generates expectations of a rise in rates," said one operator.
Another said: "The way things are, it looks as though Portugal's futures and cash market will keep falling."

The National Association of Purchasing Management's index rose to 54.0 percent in December from 52.7 percent in November. The market had anticipated a reading of 51.5 percent and U.S. Treasury bonds fell, leading other markets lower.
